0cdb569: The end credits, the 100% checklist and cheats.
f12e0d9:
# Spoiler-free by default
Tell Vicefold which chapter you're in (Settings › Spoilers). Anything after it stays hidden until you get there. Finishing a mission moves you forward on its own.
# Your map
- Tap the pin button, then tap the map to drop your own pin. Give it a name, a note, an icon and a color.
- Mark places as visited: they count toward your 100%.
- With Pro, import a screenshot of the game's full map and line it up once: your pins then sit on your real map.
# Your 100%
Missions, places, collectibles and challenges each fill a part of the ring. Share it as an image from the Tracker.
> On an iPhone Duo, open it: the list sits on one side of the fold and the details on the other.
7bedfbd: Good habits that pay off for the whole game.
8c62445:
# Follow the story first
The early missions open up the map, the shops and most activities. Side content is easier once you have a car, a phone and some cash.
# Habits worth having
- Check your phone often: new contacts, jobs and texts unlock activities.
- Keep some money aside: properties and upgrades pay back over time.
- Explore by boat as well as by car: a lot of Leonida is coastline and wetlands.
- Note anything odd on your Vicefold map with a pin: you'll want to come back to it.
> Stuck on a mission? Open it in the Tracker: objectives and tips are there, spoiler-free.

d8fbb14: Story is half of it. Here's the other half, and how much you really need.
5b2bd88:
# How the 100% is split
- Story: 50%. Finish every main mission, through the end credits.
- Tasks: 27%. Optional tasks, gang operations, bank jobs, payday loans, smash 'n' grabs, stick-ups, vaults, and money fenced.
- Exploration and activities: 20%. Collectibles, stunts, races, shooting ranges, drones, hoops, pool, mini golf and more.
- Discovery: 3%. Vehicles scanned, weapons found, animals studied.
# You don't need everything
Many categories only ask for part of the total: 15 of 18 card sets, 100 of 125 flamingos, 300 of 397 stunts, 50 of 91 stick-ups. Vicefold shows both numbers on every counter.
# Where to track it
Tracker › Collectibles has a counter for each category, with what's needed. The game's own checklist opens after the story, under Progress › Stats.
> Reaching 100% unlocks the A Long Road trophy.
2ae928b: 55 trophies, all offline. The order that saves you hours.
2610333:
# The big picture
- 55 trophies, including the platinum, Vice Got a Price! Every one is in single player: nothing online.
- Difficulty is moderate (around 4 out of 10). Time is the hard part: count 100 to 250 hours depending on how much you explore.
- About half are hidden until you earn them.
# Step 1: the story, with your eyes open
Play the story first: most trophies come along the way. Do side activities when they open up, but don't grind yet.
- Chapter 1: accept Lucia's morning meditation on the balcony after Down to Earth. It may count for Positive Mental Attitude and it disappears after chapter 1.
- Before Tourist Trap and Checking Out, save by hand: both are points of no return.
# Step 2: the 100%
After the credits, the 100% checklist opens. Reaching 100% gives the gold trophy A Long Road and most of the remaining ones along the way. Follow our 100% route guide and the counters in Tracker › Collectibles.
# Step 3: the clean-up
- Finish the Strangers & Freaks side stories: they're not part of the 100%, but some trophies need them.
- Do 70 of the 80 challenges (Tracker › Challenges).
- Hidden trophies tied to secrets, like The Truth Is Out There, are in our Easter eggs tracker.
> Cheat codes switch off trophies and saving for the session. Never use one on a save you care about.
224358f: Clear it region by region, not item by item.
6a07eea:
# The idea
Don't hunt one category at a time across the whole map. Clear a region at a time and pick up everything in it. Most categories only need part of the total, so skip the hardest ones.
# Always on
- Scan vehicles with WAiNK whenever a new model drives by (200 of 277 needed).
- Study animals with the binoculars on every trip into the wild (100 of 255).
- Pick up every magazine, book and comic you walk past (30 of 34).
# The Keys and Grassrivers, by boat
- Cocaine flamingos: shoot them from a boat (100 of 125). At 50 you unlock the Inflatable Flamingo cheat.
- Underwater discoveries and Kenton's treasure dives: all 33 discoveries count, and 5 of Kenton's 7 sets.
# Vice City, by car
- Stick-ups, smash 'n' grabs and vaults: you need every vault and 34 of 35 smash 'n' grabs, but only 50 of the 91 stick-ups.
- Basketball hoops (90 of 100), pool, mini golf (2 of 3 courses) and the video games.
# The north and the gulf coast
- Stunt jumps and bridges are thickest along the highways: 300 of 397 stunts in all.
- Meditation spots: 15 of 18, and Lucia and Jason each count on their own.
# Track it as you go
Every counter in Tracker › Collectibles shows both numbers: what exists and what the 100% asks for. Drop a pin on the map for anything you leave for later.
> Card sets are the slowest: 15 of 18 sets, out of 480 cards. Start early and swap duplicates when you can.
c782f31: Unlock them first, then enter them on the phone.
d6a0db0:
# Unlock them
Cheats open after the story, one at a time: each one has its own goal (a number of jumps, medals, kills, places found…). Vicefold lists the goal under every code.
# Enter them
1. Press up on the D-pad to open the phone.
2. Hold L1 (LB on Xbox) and press R1 (RB).
3. Enter the arrows on the D-pad.
# Before you use one
> A cheat turns off trophies and saving for the session, and what you do after it is lost when you quit. Save first.

- Chapter 1: Kirk (cryptid hunting), Shirley (errands), Kenton (treasure dives in the Keys), Cal (fishing).

# Two playlists count
Two unique playlists count toward 100%. Find the stations in More › Radio, with track lists and 30-second previews.
# A few to start with
- Vice City FM for 80s pop, V-Rock for big guitars.
- VCRR and Dirty South Classics for rap.
- Cocoteo FM and La Ola for reggaeton and salsa.
- Honey FM for slow jams, Emotion for ballads.
